cases.description: Submit, approve and publish of one meeting reach the right person's bell in real time, while each receiver has the app open.
procedure: The Approver and Member C each have "Lịch làm việc" open in their own browser.
As the Organizer submit the Draft meeting to the Approver ("Gửi duyệt").
As the Approver open the notification, click "Duyệt" and confirm.
As the Organizer click "Công bố" and confirm.
expected: The Approver's bell count rises within seconds of the submission, the newest row names the meeting and opens it with "Cuộc họp đang chờ bạn duyệt".
The Organizer's bell rises after the approval; Member C's bell does not move before publication and rises after it.
Neither the Organizer nor the Approver gets an invitation notification.
preconditions: A Draft meeting three days ahead at 17:00 organised by the Organizer with Chủ toạ Member A, Thư ký Member B, Member C.
cases.note: BF-02 · UC-66 · BR-39 · MSG78, MSG43, MSG45 · 5.2: NOTI_FT01, NOTI_FT24 · Evidence: QA run SYS-WF09 20261123-065506-0c98bde8

cases.description: Each participant of the published meeting gets an invitation email with a link to the meeting and a calendar file.
procedure: After TC01, read the email of Members A, B and C (local build: the outbox, the @trustcabinet.local domain is never mailed) and open Member C's email.
expected: Each has "Lời mời tham dự cuộc họp: <tên cuộc họp>" with a link to /mgmt/meetings/<id> and an .ics calendar attachment.
No invitation email goes to the Organizer, who is not a participant here.
cases.note: BF-02 · UC-20 · BR-39, BR-42 · 5.2: NOTI_FT29 · Local build: rows reach the outbox with status Failed "Not sent: the recipient's domain never receives mail (Email:UndeliverableDomains)"; real delivery needs a real mailbox. · Evidence: QA run SYS-WF09 20261123-065506-0c98bde8

cases.description: The calendar shows the meeting in the week and the month, and the list view shows each meeting with its current status.
procedure: As Member C open "Lịch làm việc" (work week; go to next week if needed).
expected: The week grid shows the meeting at its time; the month grid shows it on its day.
The list row shows the time, the title, the place and "Đã công bố".
cases.note: BF-02 · UC-17 · 5.2: CAL_FT01, CAL_FT02 · Evidence: QA run SYS-WF09 20261123-065506-0c98bde8
